title: swagger-rust config
description: swagger-rust.json: one API to generate, or a list of them.

url.description: OpenAPI 3 / Swagger 2 document: an http(s) url or a file path (relative to this file), JSON or YAML.

dir.description: Output directory, relative to this file. It becomes a Rust module.

methodName.description: Function name template with {method}, {path} and {operationId}. Default {method}{path}.

prefix.description: A path prefix (regular expression) left out of {path}.

includes.description: Only endpoints whose swagger-typescript style name (getPetsPetId) matches one of these regular expressions.

excludes.description: Endpoints whose name matches one of these regular expressions are skipped.

headerParams.description: Header parameters left out of the generated functions.

decode.description: strict: serde derives. lenient: tolerant decoding for backends whose JSON drifts from the schema.

propertyNaming.description: How model property names are spelled on the wire when the backend renames the document's (Spring + Jackson SNAKE_CASE documents titleFa but sends title_fa). Decoding also accepts the document's spelling.

gpui.description: Generate the GPUI layer: an HttpClient transport and cached queries.

gpuiCrate.description: The crate GPUI is used through, e.g. gpui or gpui_kit.

gpuiHttpTimeout.description: Use HttpRequestExt::timeout; turn off for GPUI versions without it.

useQuery.description: Non-GET endpoints that also get a GPUI query.

useInfiniteQuery.description: Endpoints whose GPUI query pages through page/pageNo/pageNumber/offset.

baseUrl.description: BASE_URL written into config.rs when it is first created. Default: the document's first server.

keepJson.description: Save the document as swagger.json in dir.

local.description: Generate from the swagger.json saved in dir.

rustfmt.description: Format the output with rustfmt when installed.

language.description: Accepted for compatibility with swagger-typescript configs.
